_doc: Per-wheel gear motor profiles at rated voltage (wheel-side numbers). Linear DC motor model: tau = Ts*(u*V/Vr) - (Ts/w0)*omega, current I = I0 + tau/Kt with Kt = Ts/(Istall-I0). armature = reflected rotor inertia (assumed). frictionloss = Ts*I0/Istall (no-load current share of stall torque, derived).

tt_1_48_6v.label: Stock TT 1:48 gear motor (Elegoo kit / Adafruit 3777 class), no encoder

sources.stall_torque: datasheet: Adafruit 3777 'Stall Torque (6V): 0.8kg.cm' = 0.0785 N m, https://www.adafruit.com/product/3777
sources.no_load_speed: datasheet: Adafruit 3777 'Min. Operating Speed (6V): 200 +/-10% RPM' = 20.94 rad/s (Adafruit measured 250 RPM no-load at 6 V; 200 used as conservative)
sources.stall_current: datasheet: Adafruit 3777 measured 1.5 A stalled at 6 V
sources.no_load_current: datasheet: Adafruit 3777 measured 160 mA no-load at 6 V

dfrobot_fit0450_6v.label: DFRobot FIT0450 TT motor with quadrature hall encoder, 120:1, 6 V 160 RPM (encoder TT candidate)

sources.all: datasheet: DFRobot wiki FIT0450, https://wiki.dfrobot.com/fit0450/ : no-load 160 rpm @6V, no-load current 0.17 A @6V, max stall current 2.8 A, max stall torque 0.8 kgf.cm, rated torque 0.2 kgf.cm, 16 pulses/motor rev x 120 = 1920 per wheel rev
